day_local: Axadda Lix iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira sawir yar oo maanta maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya, sawir ka duwan kuwii aan hore u soo qaadannay. Waxaan arkaa diyaarad yar oo ay ku qoran tahay 'Con Chim Airlines' oo si tartiib ah ugu dul heehaabaysa daruuraha. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya, isagoo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan iftiin iyo qorshayaal mustaqbal. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu wax walba u arko sida hawl-qabad weyn, laakiin wuxuu ahaa mid si qoto dheer ugu tiirsan xigmadda Ilaah. Ben wuxuu lahaa maskax aad u fiiqan, laakiin wuxuu lahaa qalbi ka sii weyn.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Ezekiel, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Haddii qofka xaqqa ah uu ka leexdo xaqnimadiisa oo uu sameeyo xumaan, waa inuu dhintaa... Laakiin haddii uu ka leexdo xumaantiisa, oo uu sameeyo waxa saxda ah, hubaal wuu noolaan doonaa.' Erayadan waxaa laga yaabaa inay u muuqdaan kuwo adag, laakiin dhab ahaantii, waxay inoo sheegayaan in Ilaah mar walba uu raadinayo inuu inoo soo celiyo. Wuxuu rabaa inaynu ogaanno in nolosha ay tahay hanti yar oo la inoo dhiibay si aan ugu adeegno kuwa kale. Ben wuxuu fahmay in waxa adduunkan lagu cabbiro—lacag, guul, iyo xitaa caafimaad—aysan ahayn waxa dhabta ah ee qofka ka dhiga qof weyn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa Ciise oo xertiisa u sheegaya tusaalaha labadii wiil. Midkood wuxuu yiri 'maya', laakiin wuu beddelay fikirkiisii oo wuu shaqeeyay. Midka kalena wuxuu yiri 'haa', laakiin ma uusan tegin. Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in ficilka dhabta ah uu ka qiimo badan yahay erayada madhan. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil ficilkiisu uu had iyo jeer ahaa jacayl. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa.

Saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa.

Waxaan rabaa inaan idinku dhiirrigeliyo inaad u oggolaataan in naxariista Ilaah ay bogsiiso qalbiyadiinna. U oggolow inuu kula fadhiisto, kula cuno, oo kula qaybsado xanuunkaaga. Ciise ma aha mid iska fogeeya kuwa murugaysan; wuxuu u yimid inuu la fadhiisto. Wuxuu rabaa inuu noqdo dhakhtarkaaga maanta. Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.'

Ha iloobin in jacaylka Ben uu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho oo aad igu dhex noolaato, maadaama aanan maanta kuu qaabili karin si jir ahaan ah. Igu xooji jacaylkaaga iyo rajo-gelintaada. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu u naxariisto oo uu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan reerka Ben, inuu Ilaah siiyo dulqaad, rajo, iyo nabad qalbi oo aan dunidan ka iman.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sidan ayuu Rabbigu leeyahay: 'Waxaad tidhaahdaan, 'Jidka Rabbigu ma aha mid caddaalad ah!' Bal maqla, reer Israa'iilow: Ma jidkaygu baa aan caddaalad ahayn, mise waa jidadkiinna kuwa aan caddaalad ahayn? Marka qof xaq ah uu ka leexdo xaqnimadiisa oo uu sameeyo xumaan, oo uu dhinto, waa xumaantii uu sameeyey aawadeed inuu u dhimanayo. Laakiin haddii qofka sharka leh uu ka leexdo sharkii uu sameeyey, oo uu sameeyo waxa saxda ah oo caddaalad ah, wuu badbaadin doonaa naftiisa; maadaama uu ka leexday dembiyadii uu sameeyey oo dhan, hubaal wuu noolaan doonaa, mana dhiman doono.'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Jidkaaga, Rabbiyow, ii bar; i bar waddooyinkaaga. Igu hagaaji runtaada, oo i bar, waayo adiga ayaa ah Ilaahayga badbaadiyaha ah. Rabbiyow, xusuuso naxariistaada iyo jacaylkaaga, waayo waxay ahaayeen weligood. Dembiyadii dhalinyaradayda iyo gefafkayga ha xusuusan; naxariistaada aawadeed, Rabbiyow, i xusuuso. Rabbigu waa wanaagsan yahay oo waa qumman yahay; sidaas darteed wuxuu dembiilayaasha u muujiyaa jidka. Wuxuu kuwa is-hoosaysiiya ku hagaajiyaa caddaaladda, wuxuuna kuwa is-hoosaysiiya baraa jidkiisa.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow: Haddii ay jirto wax dhiirrigelin ah oo Masiix ku jirta, ama raaxo jacayl, ama wada-jir Ruuxa, ama naxariis iyo damqasho, dhammaystira farxaddayda adinkoo isku fikir ah, isku jacayl leh, isku qalbi ah, oo hal wax ka fikiraya. Waxba ha u samaynina is-kibir ama is-muujin; laakiin is-hoosaysiin ha ku eegaan dadka kale inay idinka mudan yihiin, qof walba ha eego danaha dadka kale, ee ha eegin danihiisa oo kaliya. Ha idinku jiro fikirka uu Ciise Masiix lahaa, kaas oo ahaa inuu Ilaah ahaa, haddana aan u arkin inuu Ilaah la siman yahay wax uu ku dhegganaado. Laakiin wuu is-faaruqiyey, isagoo qaatay qaabka addoonka, isagoo u yimid si binu-aadam ah; oo markii uu binu-aadam u muuqday, wuu is-hoosaysiiyey, isagoo noqday mid addeeca ilaa dhimashada, xataa dhimashadii iskutallaabta. Sidaas darteed, Ilaah aad buu u sarreeyey, wuxuuna siiyey magac ka sarreeya magac kasta, si uu magaca Ciise jilib walba u foorarsado, kuwa samada, kuwa dhulka, iyo kuwa dhulka hoostiisa, oo carrab walbana uu u qirto in Ciise Masiix yahay Rabbiga, ammaanta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi wadaaddada sare iyo odayaasha dadka: 'Maxaad u malaynaysaan? Nin baa lahaa laba wiil. Wuxuu u yimid kii hore wuxuuna ku yidhi, 'Wiilkaygiiyow, maanta beerta canabka ah u tag oo shaqee.' Wuxuuna ugu jawaabay, 'Ma tegayo,' laakiin dabadeed wuu beddelay fikirkiisii oo wuu tegey. Ninkii wuxuu u yimid kii kalena wuxuu siiyey isla amarkii. Wuxuuna ugu jawaabay, 'Haa, sayidow,' laakiin ma uusan tegin. Kumaa labadooda sameeyey rabitaankii aabbihiis?' Waxay ugu jawaabeen, 'Kii hore.' Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, kuwa canshuur-qaadayaasha ah iyo kuwa dhillaysanaya ayaa idinka hor galaya boqortooyada Ilaah. Markii Yooxanaa idiin yimid xagga xaqnimada, idinku ma aydin rumaysan; laakiin canshuur-qaadayaashii iyo dhillaysanayaashii way rumaysteen. Xataa markii aad taas aragteen, idinku ma aydin beddelin fikirkiinna oo ma aydin rumaysan.'

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
